patterns.desc: CORE (coupon drafts): the admin coupon writes take the same tier as APPROVE_ROLES, so an approver can always post the create
the admin coupon create is gated — it had no auth at all before 2026-10-28
CORE money formula: transfer is credit-card revenue minus outcomes
the bank transfer is the raw transfer amount — no ÷1.18 for exempt stores, whose prices carry no VAT (must stay in step with totalForInvoice in routes/hyp.js)
commission is charged on the FINAL items price charged — productDiscounts must NOT be added back here (owner decision 2026-08-04), while reimbursed coupons, Shoofi compensations and drive-in stay in
card revenue is the price actually charged, not the pre-discount list price
drive-in is INSIDE the commission base and is read with this fallback chain — older orders carry only the nested driveInPricing form

shippingPrice is the COURIER's money (effectiveDeliveryFee) and is OUTSIDE the store commission base — if this moves into routes/payments/admin.js's revenue build, the base and every report on it is wrong
order.total is built from orderPrice + shippingPrice + driveIn − coupon − coins, so it is never a commission base — reports must sum orderPrice + driveIn instead
cash-vs-card driver payout branch

CORE invariant 7: the store is billed a coupon's nominal storeDiscount whenever it is not customer-specific and not full_discount — the gate is blind to discountType, so a delivery coupon lands here too

CORE invariant 7: a percentage-type coupon bills the store a percentage of the ITEMS subtotal even when its discountType is 'delivery' — couponDeliverySplit deliberately diverges and takes the share off order.shippingPrice instead (owner ruling 2026-08-12)

CORE invariant 7: couponsFromShoofi credits the discount APPLIED on the order, capped by Shoofi's share — never the coupon's nominal value per redemption (a partial-use coupon was credited in full at every store; owner decision 2026-10)
stores-export-new routes the customer-specific order_items credit through shoofiCouponCredit with the order's applied amount

CORE invariant 7: an empty shoofiDiscount on a customer-specific coupon falls back to coupon.value — INTENTIONAL, it credits back a store-paid COMP-* compensation coupon against its one-time compensationsToCustomers charge
MASAV DOS-Hebrew encoding
deleting a report releases its carry-over compensations back to pending, so the regenerated report re-bills them
store→Shoofi compensations (compensationFor 'shoofi') are an OUTCOME inside totalOutcomes — never credited back, never a coupon
every term of totalOutcomes must be a BILLING_COMPONENT, or the dashboard's reconciliation delta lies
the live overview runs the store report ENGINE over the range — it must never re-derive settlement math
delivery-fee population is the settlement one (delivered, not delivery-only), not the dashboard's completedAt
CORE invariant 9: the overview's store candidates are every non-mock store, not the live-today registry (getLiveStores dropped hidden stores that were still owed money)
CORE invariant 9: inclusion is decided on the engine output (not all zeros), with contract charges counting only for live stores

CORE invariant 3 (combo note): a line's originalPrice adds the extras portion undiscounted — for a combo that is surcharges + nested extras, and the customer-facing combo 'savings' is never part of it, so it never becomes a productDiscount
CORE invariant 3: productDiscount is derived from the order's own originalOrderPrice vs charged price — nothing else (not a combo's display savings) feeds it
movein records are separated by an EMPTY line — byte-tested against the accountant's own export
stores-tab accounts (50001 revenue / 40002 output VAT) are the accountant's, proven by their export — never guess them
drivers-tab accounts are unknown until the accountant supplies them; the export refuses (422 missing-config) meanwhile — when they land, update reference §7b
the accountant's Hashavshevet export endpoint (reference §7b)
a missing/invalid מספר תיק SKIPS the document (listed, re-downloadable via docs=) — it does not block the file (owner decision 2026-09-29); reference §7b

CORE invariant 5: the compensations-approved guard queries createdAt (a BSON Date) with Date bounds over the report's own compensation window — the old string bounds matched nothing and the guard never fired

CORE invariant 10: the store report reads compensations over exact [start, next period start) bounds — without the flag the list endpoint stretches the end to 23:59:59 and the 1st of the next month is billed twice
CORE invariant 10: a period's compensation window ends exactly where the next period's starts (same function), so consecutive reports tile with no overlap and no gap
CORE invariant 10: only the report's self-call gets exact exclusive bounds; the admin date filter keeps end-of-day stretching
CORE invariant 10: deleting a compensation is refused once a report covering its createdAt exists (add/edit/approve-item are locked by the same helper)

the 8-digit order number is DERIVED from the long three-segment form (first + last segment) — a compensation stores no short number, so if this derivation moves every report PDF and admin screen shows a different id from the apps

a bare Mongo _id is never shortened into 8 characters that read like a real order number — compensation.order.orderId IS the _id (normalizeCompensationOrder overwrites it), so a naive shortening prints a fake order number on a store payout document

the compensations screen displays the 8-digit number, so its search must expand a typed NNNN-NNNN to the stored three-segment form (262 of 2,431 rows) — reverting to a raw $regex on order.orderNumber makes the number on screen find nothing, and interpolates user input into a regex
the driver report PDF prints the 8-digit order number; the old `c.orderNumber || c.orderId` could print a bare 24-hex Mongo _id into a delivery company's payout document

store settlement PDFs are UPLOADED world-readable — the doc's 'a report PDF on Spaces is published' note. Anchored on the Body/ACL pair because a bare ACL match is also satisfied by the delete path, which would let the upload go private unnoticed
courier settlement PDFs are uploaded world-readable, same as the store ones (ACL sits after ContentType here, unlike admin-reports.js)
the bulk variant: one run republishes every historical invoice PDF world-readable. Listed in the doc because a grep of routes/ alone misses it
the worst case for guessability in the doc's note — the customer invoice key is a short sequential provider document id, not an ObjectId
the public URL is public store slug + report ObjectId. NOTE this literal appears twice (upload and deletePDFFromSpaces) — change both
the courier key is a delivery-company ObjectId, not a public slug — the doc distinguishes the two. Also duplicated in the delete path
reportId is minted client-side by the driver (no _id is set, it is read off the insert) — the basis for the doc's 'enumerable within a monthly run' claim
the pdfUrl leaves as a WhatsApp monthly_report template parameter, NOT by email (the email block above it is commented out) — that is why the link cannot be recalled
the doc points at Mongo-stored, admin-gated bytes as the pattern for a NEW internal artefact, and quotes this cap as the working number under the 16MB BSON limit

CORE invariant 7 / Known status OPEN: stores-export-new checks only `type`, never `splitType`, so a percentage-split percentage coupon's already-in-shekels storeDiscount is billed as percent points. If this line gains a splitType guard, the OPEN item is resolved — update CORE and lift DRAFT_EXCLUDED_TEMPLATES deliberately
CORE invariant 13: drafts refuse store_percentage_off until the owner rules on the percentage-split billing at routes/payments/admin.js:1190-1191

CORE invariant 13: customer-specific coupons and vouchers are always Shoofi-funded — a store share on a customer-specific coupon is never billed (admin.js:1188) and an empty shoofiDiscount is credited at coupon.value (admin.js:1180-1181)
CORE invariant 13: the 'shoofi' and 'store' funding modes are 100/0 and 0/100 PERCENT splits — never shoofiDiscount/storeDiscount = value, which settlement bills nominally

CORE invariant 13: drafts' funding is stored as splitType 'percentage' (X / 100−X) with the shekel fields nulled, and the overridden prefill is re-checked by assertTemplateInvariants — apply time resolves the share against the real discount (routes/coupon.js:67-80)
CORE invariant 13: an unanswered funding question is a blocker — approval cannot proceed on a guessed split

CORE invariant 13: buildCreateFields puts targeting TOP-LEVEL — routes/coupon.js create reads req.body.stores, and the nested applicableTo alone creates a platform-wide coupon (the store that gets billed)
CORE invariant 13: drafts, code reservation, translations and settle use the central shoofi DB only — never the app-name header the create route trusts
CORE invariant 13 (negative pin): the drafts router never writes shoofi.coupons — approval returns CouponForm fields and the coupon is created only by the unchanged POST /api/admin/coupon/create
CORE invariant 13 (negative pin): the drafts service is pure — no writes of any kind
CORE invariant 13: settle-on-read — an approving draft whose reserved code exists is marked created, so one draft can never create a second coupon
CORE invariant 13: the plain #320 picker turns a too-low amount under the fixed default split into a 422 — the too-HIGH case is still silent there
CORE invariant 13: the create route still picks its DB from the app-name header with no 'shoofi' fallback, while apply and settlement read shoofi — the reason drafts pin the central DB

patterns.regex: if \(coupon\.splitType === 'percentage'\) return \{ share: Number\(coupon\.storePercent\) \|\| 0, full: 100 \};\s*[\r\n]+\s*return \{ share: Number\(coupon\.storeDiscount\) \|\| 0, full: Number\(coupon\.value\) \|\| 0 \};
patterns.desc: CORE invariant 14: the store's share alone decides who funds a global coupon — storePercent (of 100) for a percent split, else storeDiscount (of value); shoofiDiscount is never read for a public coupon (routes/payments/admin.js:1209)

CORE invariant 14: the three thresholds — no store share = Shoofi, a share covering the whole value = store, anything between = split (mirrors the truthy storeDiscount gate at routes/payments/admin.js:1188)
CORE invariant 14: customer-specific coupons (never billed to a store) and value-0 tag coupons are outside the funder classification
CORE invariant 14: the Mongo 'shoofi' bucket — null/0/missing store share on either split shape (noShare = $in [null, 0])
CORE invariant 14: the Mongo 'store' bucket — storePercent >= 100, or a fixed storeDiscount covering the whole value
CORE invariant 14: the Mongo 'split' bucket — 0 < storePercent < 100, or 0 < storeDiscount < value

patterns.desc: CORE invariant 14: 'in effect now' converts start/end (strings with mixed +02:00/+03:00 offsets) to dates — never a text comparison
CORE invariant 14: GET /api/admin/coupons isActive=now = switched on AND within its dates, via activeNowFilter
CORE invariant 14: GET /api/admin/coupons funder=shoofi|store|split filters through funderFilter ($and-merged); any other value is a 400
CORE invariant 14: each admin coupons row carries its funder, from the same rule as the filter
CORE invariant 15: a fixed-delivery-price discount is min(cap, max(0, fee − deliveryPrice)) — never min(value, fee), never below 0

patterns.regex: if \(coupon\.deliveryPrice === null \|\| coupon\.deliveryPrice === undefined \|\| coupon\.deliveryPrice === ""\) return 0;
patterns.desc: CORE invariant 15: a missing deliveryPrice is ₪0 off, not 'free delivery up to the cap' (Number(null) is 0)
CORE invariant 15: a fixed-delivery-price coupon's value is a cap, never a cash balance (isCashValuedCoupon)
CORE invariants 7/15: a percent split is resolved into shekels of the discount ACTUALLY given (resolveCouponSplit, moved here from routes/coupon.js)

patterns.regex: if \(splitType !== 'percentage'\) return 'A fixed delivery price coupon must use a percentage split
patterns.desc: CORE invariant 15: a fixed-delivery-price coupon must be a percent split — a fixed store share is billed nominally (routes/payments/admin.js:1192-1194) while the discount swings from ₪0 to the cap
CORE invariant 15: value is the cap and is mirrored into maxDiscount
CORE invariant 15: creation keeps min(posted, server) — never more than quoted, never more than the server's number
CORE invariant 15: the fee is taken AFTER a kept store delivery deal, so coupon + deal never exceed the fee (no CASH courier over-repayment)
CORE invariant 15: the posted fee is capped at the area's real tariff before the discount is computed
CORE invariant 15: the store/Shoofi shares are re-resolved against the corrected discount from the coupon DOCUMENT
CORE invariant 15: order creation runs the fixed-delivery-price guard
CORE invariant 15: amend writes the re-resolved shares together with the new discount
